name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Shot Tracking for Claude Code: what needs a producer's attention

sections.title: Shots due in the next ten days
sections.note: Anything without an approved version is at risk.
sections.sql: select sp.show, sp.shot, sp.status, sp.due_on, sp.due_on - current_date as days_left, sp.latest_version from shot_progress sp where sp.status not in ('delivered','omitted') and sp.due_on <= current_date + 10 order by sp.due_on

sections.title: Versions waiting on a review
sections.sql: select v.ref, v.status, v.submitted_on, case when v.status = 'pending_client' then current_date - v.sent_to_client_on else current_date - v.submitted_on end as waiting_days from versions v where v.status in ('pending_internal','pending_client') order by waiting_days desc

sections.title: Client notes not addressed
sections.sql: select coalesce(sh.ref, a.ref) as shot, n.noted_on, current_date - n.noted_on as age_days, n.body from notes n left join shots sh on sh.id = n.shot_id left join assets a on a.id = n.asset_id where n.from_client and n.addressed_on is null order by n.noted_on

sections.title: Change orders undecided
sections.sql: select co.ref, sh.ref as shot, co.description, co.days, co.status, current_date - co.raised_on as age_days from change_orders co left join shots sh on sh.id = co.shot_id where co.status in ('raised','sent') order by co.raised_on

name: shot-board
title: Shot board
subtitle: Every shot, its status, bid and actual days

sections.title: All shots
sections.sql: select show, shot, sequence, status, due_on, bid_days, actual_days, pct_of_bid, latest_version from shot_progress order by show, shot

name: bid-vs-actual
title: Bid against actual
subtitle: Where the bid was wrong, by shot and by department step

sections.title: Shots over bid
sections.sql: select show, shot, status, bid_days, actual_days, pct_of_bid from shot_progress where bid_days > 0 and actual_days > bid_days order by pct_of_bid desc

sections.title: By step
sections.sql: select step, count(*) as tasks, sum(bid_days) as bid_days, sum(actual_days) as actual_days, round(100 * sum(actual_days) / nullif(sum(bid_days), 0)) as pct_of_bid from task_actuals group by step order by pct_of_bid desc nulls last

name: rebate
title: Rebate spend
subtitle: Qualifying spend against each scheme's threshold

sections.title: By show
sections.note: Labour is logged time at each person's day rate where the work was done in the scheme's country. Vendor spend counts only with an evidence reference.
sections.sql: select show, scheme, qualifying_cents, threshold_cents, gap_cents, rebate_estimate_cents, outside_country_cents, no_evidence_cents, currency from rebate_spend order by show
